titleEn: 996 (jiǔ jiǔ liù): China's Overtime Culture in Three Digits
summaryEn: 996 means 9am to 9pm, six days a week — shorthand for China's overtime culture, the spark of the 996.ICU protests, and now an international loanword.
emotionEquivalent: 加班文化 / 超时工作

symbolLayer.explanation: 用极简数字压缩一整套作息制度（早 9 晚 9、每周 6 天），汉语数字构词的典型样本
symbolLayer.explanationEn: Three digits compressing a whole work schedule (9am to 9pm, six days a week) — a classic Chinese numeral construction.

origin: 2010s 中国互联网公司普遍工时；2019 年「996.ICU」GitHub 项目引爆全球技术社区关注，程序员以此抗议超长工时
originEn: Standard 2010s working hours at Chinese internet companies; in 2019 the '996.ICU' GitHub project drew global tech-community attention as programmers protested.
usage: 形容高强度、无薪加班的工作制度；也作反讽引用（「996 是福报」）
usageEn: Describes a high-intensity, unpaid-overtime work regime; also used ironically ('996 is a blessing').
commonMisreading: 海外媒体常简化为「中国人全都在超负荷工作」，实际是特定行业（互联网/初创）现象，且伴随公开的劳动者抵制运动
commonMisreadingEn: Overseas media often reduce it to 'all Chinese people are overworking'; it's specific to tech and startup industries and was accompanied by public labor protests.

memeLineage.event: 互联网公司普遍实行 996 工时，程序员社区开始用「996」指代
memeLineage.eventEn: Internet companies adopt the 996 schedule; the term spreads in programmer communities

memeLineage.event: 「996.ICU」GitHub 项目发布，星数一度登顶全球 Trending
马云「996 是福报」言论引发全网反讽，衍生「福报」梗
memeLineage.eventEn: Jack Ma's '996 is a blessing' remark fuels an ironic backlash and the 'blessing' meme

memeLineage.event: 最高法明确「996」违法，BBC/NYT 等跟进报道，「996」成为英语借词
memeLineage.eventEn: Supreme People's Court rules 996 illegal; BBC/NYT follow up; '996' becomes an English loanword

memeLineage.event: 大小周取消潮，「996」从普遍现象退为历史符号
memeLineage.eventEn: 'Big small week' schedules phased out; 996 becomes a historical symbol
